title: Combo Tour of Sagrada Familia and Park Guell
text:
Both tour guides were excellent. Anna was the tour guide for Sagrada Familia and Gonzalo was the tour guide for Park Guell. 

Overall, it was a positive experience. A little bit more coordination with the initial meeting place will be helpful. Both of these places are big, and it is sometime hard to find the tour guide. For example, a big sign showing the tour name, etc., will be helpful.

title: Good tours, friendly people.
text: Great tour. Not too long, but long enough to fit in the essential sights. Great guides, different guides for each location, very knowledgeable. Location o meeting points are not always at the gates so check the booking instructions thoroughly. Admission was fast and smooth without queuing.
author: abyssinias2024

title: Fantastic tour!! I highly recommend it!!
text:
The guided tours through the Sagrada Família and park Güell were amazing! Albert had incredible knowledge, stories and pictures to share throughout our tour of the exterior and interior!! I would definitely request him and do this tour again. 
Lena was our park guell guide and also had a lot of knowledge and pictures. I had been to both places before but never with a guide walking me through them and I would highly recommend this tour!!
author: Patty_S

title: Pure happiness
text:
We really enjoyed the visits with Yassir from Agrado Familia and Park Güell.  A guide very passionate about Gaudí and his masterpieces. You can see that being a guide is a passion he shares willingly. 
Thank you
